import math
import factors


def factor_trend_quality(bars):
    """Volatility-adjusted trend: slope of log close over 40 days divided by realized vol, positive = clean uptrend."""
    n = len(bars["close"])
    if n < 45:
        return float("nan")
    slope = factors.trend_slope(bars, n=40)
    vol = factors.realized_vol(bars, n=40)
    if vol is None or math.isnan(vol) or vol <= 0:
        return float("nan")
    return slope / vol


def factor_breakout_volume(bars):
    """20-day Donchian breakout confirmed by above-average volume; +1 strong up-break, -1 down-break, else 0."""
    n = len(bars["close"])
    if n < 25:
        return 0.0
    br = factors.donchian_breakout(bars, n=20)
    vr = factors.volume_ratio(bars, n=20)
    if br is None or vr is None or math.isnan(br) or math.isnan(vr):
        return 0.0
    if br > 0 and vr > 1.1:
        return 1.0
    if br < 0 and vr > 1.1:
        return -1.0
    return 0.0


def factor_momentum_blend(bars):
    """Blend of 60-day ROC and risk-adjusted 60-day momentum, scaled to roughly -1..1."""
    n = len(bars["close"])
    if n < 65:
        return float("nan")
    roc = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    sm = factors.sharpe_mom(bars, n=60)
    if roc is None or sm is None or math.isnan(roc) or math.isnan(sm):
        return float("nan")
    return 0.5 * math.tanh(roc * 5.0) + 0.5 * math.tanh(sm / 2.0)


def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = close[-1]
    pos = account.get("position", 0)
    entry = account.get("entry_price")

    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    sma50 = factors.sma(arr, 50)
    if n >= 200:
        sma_long = factors.sma(arr, 200)
    else:
        sma_long = factors.sma(arr, 100)

    regime_up = (not math.isnan(sma50)) and (not math.isnan(sma_long)) and sma50 > sma_long and price > sma50

    tq = factor_trend_quality(bars)
    bv = factor_breakout_volume(bars)
    mb = factor_momentum_blend(bars)

    # Composite score: sum of weakly-predictive signals
    score = 0.0
    if regime_up:
        score += 1.0
    if not math.isnan(mb):
        score += mb
    if not math.isnan(tq):
        score += math.tanh(tq * 10.0)
    score += bv

    if pos > 0:
        if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.88:
            return ("SELL", "stop loss 12% below entry")
        if (not math.isnan(sma50)) and price < sma50:
            return ("SELL", "price below SMA50")
        return "HOLD"

    # Looser entry: stay invested when the medium-term trend is up, even if the
    # composite score is only mildly positive. This avoids sitting in cash through
    # recoveries (the main cause of the recent alpha erosion).
    if regime_up and score > 0.0:
        return ("BUY", "trend regime up with positive composite score")
    if score > 1.0:
        return ("BUY", "strong composite score")
    return "HOLD"

v001initial · written 2024-11-01 (2024-W44) · parent -live 2024-11-01 → 2024-11-15 (11 sessions): +0.00% vs buy & hold +5.50% (alpha -5.50 pp)
I use a trend-following core (50/200-day SMA regime plus 20-day breakout) confirmed by volume and momentum, since COP is a cyclical energy stock where medium-term trends tend to persist. I designed a volatility-adjusted trend factor and a volume-confirmed breakout factor to reduce whipsaws. I would switch to mean-reversion if backtests show the trend signals underperform buy-and-hold, or tighten stops if drawdowns are large.
import math
import factors


def factor_trend_quality(bars):
    """Volatility-adjusted trend: slope of log close over 40 days divided by realized vol, positive = clean uptrend."""
    n = len(bars["close"])
    if n < 45:
        return float("nan")
    slope = factors.trend_slope(bars, n=40)
    vol = factors.realized_vol(bars, n=40)
    if vol is None or math.isnan(vol) or vol <= 0:
        return float("nan")
    return slope / vol


def factor_breakout_volume(bars):
    """20-day Donchian breakout confirmed by above-average volume; +1 strong up-break, -1 down-break, else 0."""
    n = len(bars["close"])
    if n < 25:
        return 0.0
    br = factors.donchian_breakout(bars, n=20)
    vr = factors.volume_ratio(bars, n=20)
    if br is None or vr is None or math.isnan(br) or math.isnan(vr):
        return 0.0
    if br > 0 and vr > 1.1:
        return 1.0
    if br < 0 and vr > 1.1:
        return -1.0
    return 0.0


def factor_momentum_blend(bars):
    """Blend of 60-day ROC and risk-adjusted 60-day momentum, scaled to roughly -1..1."""
    n = len(bars["close"])
    if n < 65:
        return float("nan")
    roc = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    sm = factors.sharpe_mom(bars, n=60)
    if roc is None or sm is None or math.isnan(roc) or math.isnan(sm):
        return float("nan")
    return 0.5 * math.tanh(roc * 5.0) + 0.5 * math.tanh(sm / 2.0)


def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = close[-1]
    pos = account.get("position", 0)
    entry = account.get("entry_price")

    # Core regime: 50 vs 200 SMA (fall back to 50 vs 100 if short)
    sma50 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 50)
    if n >= 200:
        sma_long = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 200)
    else:
        sma_long = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 100)
    regime_up = (not math.isnan(sma50)) and (not math.isnan(sma_long)) and sma50 > sma_long and price > sma50

    tq = factor_trend_quality(bars)
    bv = factor_breakout_volume(bars)
    mb = factor_momentum_blend(bars)

    # Exit rules when holding
    if pos > 0:
        # hard stop: 8% below entry
        if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.92:
            return ("SELL", "stop loss 8% below entry")
        # trend break: price below 50-day SMA and momentum negative
        if (not math.isnan(sma50)) and price < sma50 and (not math.isnan(mb)) and mb < -0.1:
            return ("SELL", "price below SMA50 with negative momentum blend")
        # breakdown with volume
        if bv < 0:
            return ("SELL", "volume-confirmed Donchian breakdown")
        return "HOLD"

    # Entry rules when flat
    if not regime_up:
        return "HOLD"
    if math.isnan(tq) or math.isnan(mb):
        return "HOLD"
    if tq > 0.02 and mb > 0.05 and bv >= 0:
        return ("BUY", "uptrend regime with positive trend quality and momentum blend")
    return "HOLD"
